meaning: Content checked against the named reproduced scans. This is attributed-document support, not independent authentication of paper originals or a complete office history.

claims.locator: Second sitting: heading, printed p. 58 (PDF p. 60); remark, printed p. 98 (PDF p. 100)

claims.locator: First sitting: heading, printed p. 3 (PDF p. 5); statement, printed p. 14 (PDF p. 16)

claims.locator: First sitting, printed p. 64 (PDF p. 66)

claims.locator: Sixth sitting: heading, printed p. 325 (PDF p. 327); speech, printed p. 361 (PDF p. 363)

claims.locator: Sixth sitting, printed p. 361 (PDF p. 363)

claims.locator: Eighteenth sitting: heading, printed p. 66 (PDF p. 68); speech, printed p. 88 (PDF p. 90)

claims.locator: Eighteenth sitting: after the break, printed p. 91 (PDF p. 93); statement, printed pp. 136-137 (PDF pp. 138-139)

claims.locator: Twentieth sitting: heading, printed p. 206 (PDF p. 208); statement, printed p. 231 (PDF p. 233)

claims.locator: Fifteenth sitting: heading, printed p. 366 (PDF p. 368); registration, printed pp. 421-422 (PDF pp. 423-424)

claims.finding: Anonymous appeal describes a planned march/meeting after the Council's approved application. Report past-tense occurrence corrected; structured claim already bounded.

claims.locator: Bulletin No. 1: sitting heading, printed p. 3 (PDF p. 3); remark, printed p. 22 (PDF p. 22)
claims.finding: Bogdanov refers to unnamed leaders in an earlier incident; no exact offices or terms inferred.

claims.finding: Boyars makes an accusatory proposal naming five leaders; it is not an adjudicated finding or five co-chair attestations.

claims.locator: Bulletin No. 2, printed p. 88 (PDF p. 30)

claims.locator: Bulletin No. 3: sitting heading, printed p. 3 (PDF p. 3); speech, printed p. 24 (PDF p. 24)

claims.locator: Leaf 1 (facsimile p. 1): letter, signatures, date and registration mark
claims.finding: Signed co-chair letter supports Afanasyev on the written 12 September date; 12 October is a receipt mark, not the letter's day.

claims.locator: Leaf 1 (facsimile p. 1): letter, signatures, date and registration mark
claims.finding: The same letter supports Ponomarev on the written date; no exclusive chairmanship inferred.

claims.locator: Leaf 1 (facsimile p. 1): letter, signatures, date and registration mark
claims.finding: The same letter supports only A. Murashev as printed; initial is not expanded to an inferred full name.

claims.locator: Leaf 5 (facsimile p. 5): heading, approval line and signature block
claims.finding: Delegation list has a co-chair signature and an approval date; signature itself is not separately dated. Claim only, not a holder observation.

claims.locator: Leaf 5 (facsimile p. 5): approval line
claims.finding: Approval line supports Council plenum on 15 September; it does not date the undated signature independently.

claims.locator: Leaf 129 (facsimile p. 1): the card and its signature
claims.finding: Invitation prints 9-10 November but no year and no election result. Structured claim correctly remains undated; filename/catalogue year is not promoted.

claims.locator: Leaf 128 (facsimile p. 1): heading, entry 1, registration mark and preparer
claims.finding: President's office participant list explicitly names Yakunin as one of two co-chairs on 12 December; not a sole office or term boundary.

claims.locator: Leaf 128 (facsimile p. 1): heading, entry 1, registration mark and preparer
claims.finding: Same list explicitly names Ponomarev as co-chair; other participants lacking the title are not promoted.
